column1: # A failure in the Integration job that ruling 104 counts as foreign (fixed
# only by an upstream release this repository pins, named on an open upstream
# issue) does not block a merge. The job passes when every failed leaf test is
# a row below and the run adds no failure main lacks at the same tip;
# scripts/foreignfailures decides it, and anything it cannot attribute to a
# listed leaf (a build failure, a panic or timeout, a package that fails with
# no failing test, a target that fails outside go test) still gates.
# Only ruling-104 foreign classes may be listed. A row names exactly one leaf
# test (kind test: the full subtest name in its module-relative package) or one
# runner target (kind job: an ALL_TARGETS name in run-integration-tests.sh); no
# wildcards or patterns, so a new failure can never hide under a row. upstream
# is the open issue, repo#number (several joined by +); closing_release is the
# release whose adoption fixes it. A row is removed in the PR that adopts its
# closing release. arm-merge stays the one gate; nothing is admin-merged.
